requirement.description: The MemoryData class is referenced in tests but not defined in the current codebase. Tests like test_hdl_mem.py::MemoryDataTestCase::test_repr expect a MemoryData class to exist in amaranth.hdl._mem module.
requirement.contract: Add the MemoryData class definition to the amaranth/hdl/_mem.py file with appropriate methods for representation, indexing, and simulation operations.

requirement.description: Tests like test_lib_memory.py::ReadPortTestCase::test_constructor and test_lib_memory.py::WritePortTestCase::test_constructor fail because Memory objects don't have read_ports and write_ports attributes. The lib/memory.py implementation needs to expose these properties.
requirement.contract: Add read_ports and write_ports properties to the Memory class in amaranth/lib/memory.py that return tuples of the respective port objects.

requirement.description: Import issue - MemoryData is not imported in the test file. This prevents tests from accessing the MemoryData class.
requirement.contract: Update the import statement in tests/test_hdl_mem.py to properly import MemoryData from amaranth.hdl._mem.
